source: Lets make 3d game with floating island kingdoms with waterfalls,brigdes and a giant crystal castle and around the island you can find 5 diffrent temples with 5 diffrent bosses you can fight and earn coins to unlock new weapons and when you first start make the player equip a katana and when the equip it make some mobs spawn for them to fight so they can updgrade from a katana. also make it when you have 1,000 coins you can create your own clans to go out on adventures and experience and fight new enemies. also make the map 1,000,000,000,000 blocks big. and when you get enough xp make it so you can level up and unlock new maps and the max level right now is level 5,000.

answers.ask: A trillion blocks is not buildable - do you want one island cluster you can cross in a couple of minutes, or a set of separate maps unlocked as you level?
answers.answer: Use a set of separate maps unlocked as the player levels up; this keeps the huge-world feeling while making progression playable.

answers.ask: Crystal castle plus katana could read as bright anime-fantasy or as solemn high fantasy - which look do you want?
answers.answer: Use a bright anime-fantasy look, with colorful floating islands, glowing crystals, and dramatic waterfalls.

answers.ask: Are the five temples on the main island, or is each one its own floating island reached by bridge?
answers.answer: Make each of the five temples its own floating island reached by bridges from the main crystal-castle island.

scene_prompt: Create a bright anime-fantasy 3D game map built as a cluster of colorful floating islands with glowing crystals and dramatic waterfalls dropping into the clouds below. The central main island holds a giant crystal castle, with five separate temple islands arranged around it and connected by long bridges; each temple is visually distinct and serves as a boss arena. Design this as the starting map within a set of separate level-unlocked maps, creating the feeling of a vast world without one continuous trillion-block landmass.
blob:
### Genre
The dominant genre is RPG, signalled by the progression, combat, equipment, currency, and level-unlocked world structure in the original request. This is an action-oriented fantasy RPG, but Action is not a secondary genre because the RPG progression structure owns the world layout.

### Shape and preset
Use `world-hub-dungeon`: the starting map is a central hub island with five outward boss-temple destinations. The closest preset is Action RPG, but the prompt overrides it: this is not a sanctuary town with mob nests, and the temples are exterior floating-island arenas rather than conventional enclosed dungeons. The preset is therefore none.

### Config requirements
Use visible `landmark-focal` for the giant crystal castle as the central orientation anchor. Use visible `hazard-aggro` for the five temple forecourts, each formed as a distinct open boss-arena clearing. Use visible `island-cluster` for the central island plus five separate temple islands linked across open air. Use visible `water-body` for waterfalls spilling from island edges into the clouds. No invisible emitters, pickups, triggers, or spawn markers are required by the scene description.

### Layout components
Build one large starting-map island cluster. Place the broad main island at the center, dominated by a giant glowing crystal castle on its highest central ground. Arrange exactly five visually distinct temple islands in a loose ring around it, each separated by cloud-filled void and connected directly to the main island by a long, readable bridge. Each outer island has one temple and a generous open apron around it for its arena role; vary their silhouettes, crystal colors, roof forms, and surrounding waterfalls without adding extra destinations. Waterfalls descend from the main island and selected temple-island cliffs into the cloud layer below. Use colorful grassy rock islands with crystal outcrops and sheer broken edges; the open-air void is the boundary, with no enclosing wall. Frame the castle as the compositional center and let the five bridges radiate outward clearly from an elevated isometric view. This cluster is the first of several separate level-unlocked maps, not a trillion-block continuous landmass.

### Render order
Use `topdown` first, then dress it isometrically, because every temple island must remain connected to the castle by a clear traversable bridge and a broken connection would make the starting map unusable.

### Scale, theme, and pipeline cost
Scale band: large for the substantial six-island starting cluster, while the wider world is distributed across separate maps. Theme: bright anime fantasy, colorful floating land, luminous crystals, and dramatic cloudfall waterfalls. Use `P4` because progression leads to genuinely separate world maps. No interior transition is specified, so do not add P3; the visible starting cluster itself remains exterior and bridge-connected.
